name: Satkhira

queries.query: Satkhira Bangladesh official cadastral map parcel land records map
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Department of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS) / Ministry of Land official land-map viewer, the official DLRS map-purchase system for CS, SA, RS, BRS and BDS mouza maps, and an official Satkhira municipality master-plan PDF showing parcel-numbered ward mapping. The public map viewer's current JavaScript points to the government GeoServer/WFS route, but no usable Satkhira parcel feature response was obtained.

queries.query: বাংলাদেশ সাতক্ষীরা সরকারি মৌজা মানচিত্র ভূমি রেকর্ড ক্যাডাস্ট্রাল
queries.result: The Bengali discovery route returned the official online land-record/survey portal, official map viewer, DLRS mouza-map acquisition instructions, and Satkhira-related official map documents. It did not expose a safe anonymous Satkhira parcel ID-plus-geometry download.

researchNote: Official Bangladesh DLRS/Ministry of Land cadastral map and survey routes were evidenced, with Satkhira-specific official map material. This packet records source discovery and qualification only; it is not source integration, runtime admission, or evidence of citywide parcel absence.
